opening-pedal.hears: Before the tune: the horns' soft held note out of silence (one F#4 in the pack, 1.02-3.77 s, v16). A deliberate, spare entrance.

phrase-entries.hears: Every entry of the motif: the first note of each 2-bar unit, a stroke every 4.2 s at the start, every 2.9 s in the frenzy (34 units; the clock the accelerando really keeps).
phrase-entries.rule: theme note in slot 0 of each unit; where the transcription has none, the audio onset within 0.08 s of the fitted unit start (pitch: the lowest B or F# in the register of the unit, nominal; velocity 96 = -12 dB)

theme.hears: The tune itself, every note of all 34 phrase units (3.7-130.6 s): tiptoeing pp in the low strings and bassoons, then up through the winds and violins, faster and louder, to the tutti. One note per eighth slot of the tune: the doubled octaves are one note.
theme.rule: the unit grid (see ANALYSIS) refitted per unit; per template slot the note of the right pitch class within max(0.05, 0.3 d) of the slot, roll before pack, then loudest, then highest; unmatched slots left out

theme-climbs.hears: The climbing first bar of every unit (B C# D E F# D F#, or F# G# A# B C# A# C#): the creep up the stairs, 7-8 notes, then a gap.
theme-climbs.rule: theme notes in slots 0-7 of each unit

theme-minor.hears: The B-minor half of the tune (the A units: B C# D E F# D F# | F C# F E C E and the B ... A F# D F# A answer): 0-20.9, 37.7-71.0, 87.0-114.1, 125.6-130.6 s.
theme-minor.rule: theme notes of the A and A2 units

theme-pizz-basses.hears: The first statement, pp: cellos and double basses pizzicato tiptoeing the tune in the dark (B1-B2), under the horn pedal; and their return at 37.7 s. The literal footsteps.
theme-pizz-basses.rule: theme notes of units 1-2 (3.7-12.5 s) and 9-10 (37.7-46.2 s)

low-strings-lane.hears: Cellos and basses (and the strings section below D3): pizzicato under statements 1-2, then the sawing bass of the frenzy.
low-strings-lane.rule: roll, tracks cello, contrabass and strings, midi < 50; the lowest of each 40 ms cluster

pizz-footsteps.hears: The pizzicato accompaniment under the tune in statements 1-2: short low plucks (below D3) that are not the tune, the trolls' footfalls on the beat.
pizz-footsteps.rule: roll notes of the cello, contrabass and strings lanes and pack notes, 3.7-101.85 s, midi < 50, length <= 0.6 s, not a theme note; the lowest of each 40 ms cluster, a pitch repeated within 0.15 s dropped

theme-landings.hears: Where each run lands and holds: the quarter and half notes of the tune (F#, F, E, the long A; C#, D, C#). The stresses of the march, about two a bar.
theme-landings.rule: theme notes of slots whose template length is >= 2 eighths

theme-answers.hears: The second bar of every unit, the answer (F C# F E C E, the A F# D F# A sigh, D A# D C# A# C#): the trolls turning round.
theme-answers.rule: theme notes in slots 8-15 of each unit

bassoon-lane.hears: Everything the bassoon lane has (B1-D4): the tune in statement 1, the low winds' pedal and answers in statement 2.
bassoon-lane.rule: roll, track bassoon; the top of each 40 ms cluster (octave doubles are one attack)

reeds-lane.hears: Oboe and clarinet lanes: thin, nasal, mostly statement 1-2 (10-100 s), the clarinet's held chords at 10.4 s, the oboe octaves at 60-70 s; and a mislabelled tutti blast at 144 s left out.
reeds-lane.rule: roll, tracks oboe and clarinet, before 140 s; the top of each 40 ms cluster

long-a-sighs.hears: The longest notes of the tune: the held A (a half note) that closes every A2 unit, 1 s long in the first statement, shorter later. The only long slow notes before the coda.
long-a-sighs.rule: per A2 unit before 101.85 s: the longest A (any lane, roll before pack) starting within 0.12 s of slot 12, in the unit register +- 12, length >= 0.4 s

theme-bassoons.hears: The bassoons take the tune (B2-B3), sneaking, staccato: 12.5-20.9 s, again with clarinet and horn in the F# half at 29.4-37.7 s, and at 46.2-54.9 s.

theme-low-strings-f-sharp.hears: Violas and cellos, still pp, carry the first F#-major half (F#2-C#4), 20.9-29.4 s.

theme-major.hears: The F#-major half of the tune (F# G# A# B C# A# C# | D A# D C# A# C#): 20.9-37.7, 71.0-87.0, 114.1-125.6 s. Brighter, higher.
theme-major.rule: theme notes of the B and B2 units

violins-high.hears: The violins above C5 (and the strings section there): the tune's top line from 56 s, glittering at the top of the frenzy (to C#7).
violins-high.rule: roll, tracks violin and strings, midi >= 72; the top of each 40 ms cluster

brass-lane.hears: Brass, horn and trumpet lanes: a few horn notes in statement 1 (30-33 s), then brass blasts in the frenzy (100-131 s). Sparse: 95 notes in all.
brass-lane.rule: roll, tracks brass, horn and trumpet, before 140 s (the trumpet lane at 144 s is the tutti blows, mislabelled); the top of each 40 ms cluster

theme-violins-enter.hears: The second statement opens two octaves up, light and dry: the violins and the strings section (B4-F#5) over soft repeated B-minor chords, 54.9-63.0 s.

theme-winds.hears: Oboe, clarinet and bassoon in octaves take the B-minor half (B3-B5), 63.0-71.0 s: reedy, a little louder.

theme-strings-rising.hears: The F#-major half and the B-minor return in the strings, everyone joining, crescendo and accelerando (71.0-101.85 s; 87-101.85 s is the big push).

cymbal-pulse.hears: The cymbal strokes of the frenzy, about every 0.75 s (two to a bar), 101.9-135.7 s: the transcription has none of them. A steady metallic pulse from the downbeat of statement 3.
cymbal-pulse.rule: audio: 4-11 kHz onset peaks with a >= 8 dB jump, 101.4-135.8 s; pitch B6 (95) nominal, length 0.2 s, velocity from dB

theme-tutti.hears: The frenzy: full orchestra, ff, the tune in the violins on top (B5-F#6) over cymbals, 101.85-130.6 s. The transcription catches it in part: see the unit scores.

frenzy-tremolo.hears: The strings' tremolo and repeated notes of the frenzy: one pitch hammered 3+ times (the held F#5 at 119.2-120.1, the A tremolo at 129.35-130.9, the B-minor chord at 131.1). Glitter, not tune.
frenzy-tremolo.rule: roll notes 101.85-136 s, midi >= 60, the same pitch again within 0.22 s, runs of 3 or more; the top of each 40 ms cluster

stamping-bass.hears: The bass of the frenzy, ff (cellos, basses, timpani in the low band): the lowest note of each loud attack below C3, 101.85-136.0 s.
stamping-bass.rule: roll+pack clusters 101.85-136 s; the lowest note if it is < 48 and velocity >= 60

break-chord.hears: The tune snaps off: a B-minor chord hammered ff in tremolo, 131.08-133.1 s (cellos B2, violins B4 D5 D6). The first time the music stands still.
break-chord.rule: roll notes 131.0-131.1 s (the first attack) and those starting 131.4-131.5 s that last >= 1 s (the chord held to 133.1 s); the tremolo strokes between are in frenzy-tremolo

break-turn.hears: After the chord, a turning figure in octaves, C# D E D C# B (133.18-134.1 s), then B hammered to the crash at 135.3 s.
break-turn.rule: roll clusters 133.1-134.7 s; the top of each, a pitch repeated within 0.2 s dropped

coda-chords.hears: The blows as the transcription has them: the low tutti chords at 136.43, 139.58, 140.55, 143.67, 144.64, 145.62 s, whole (E1-F2, the timpani and basses).
coda-chords.rule: pack clusters 136-146 s within 0.1 s of a BLOWS time, whole

ff-blows.hears: The hammer blows of the coda: six fff tutti strokes, each out of a near-silence (136.46, 139.62, 140.59, 143.71, 144.67, 145.66 s), then the final chord (149.69 s). The only real ff blows of the piece: the Fireworks set.
ff-blows.rule: audio: 20-200 Hz onset peaks after 130 s with a peak >= -6 dB and a jump >= 15 dB, plus the loudest stroke of the final crescendo; pitch B1 (35) nominal (the transcription reads the bass drum as E1/A#1); length 0.4 s; velocity from dB

coda-crashes.hears: The cymbal crash a quarter second after each blow (136.72, 139.89, 140.84, 143.98, 144.94 s) and the last crash at 149.97 s: the splash after the hammer.
coda-crashes.rule: audio: 4-11 kHz onset peaks after 136 s with a >= 20 dB jump, the final crescendo's own strokes left out; pitch B6 (95) nominal, length 0.5 s, velocity from dB

stretta-runs.hears: Between the blows the tune runs on at double speed, f then hushed (137.2-139.4 s and 141.5-143.5 s): B C# D E F# ... scurrying.
stretta-runs.rule: roll+pack clusters 136.9-139.5 s and 140.95-143.6 s, velocity >= 40; the top of each

held-breath.hears: After the last blow: a hushed diminished chord (F G# D) repeated five times, 145.9-146.9 s, rising to D/B at 147.1-147.4 s, then the general pause (147.75-148.6 s, -30 dB).

final-strokes.hears: Out of the general pause, the last crescendo: three strokes louder and louder (148.98, 149.31, 149.69 s), the final chord, then the crash at 149.97 s and nothing (silent by 151.5 s).
final-strokes.rule: audio onsets of the final crescendo; pitch B1 (35) nominal for the strokes, B6 (95) for the crash; velocity from dB
